title: Online Causal Inference for Advertising in Real-Time Bidding Auctions
authors: Caio Waisman; Harikesh S. Nair; Carlos Carrión
eligible_reason: Multiarmed-bandit method for online causal inference of ad effects in real-time-bidding auctions; results come from simulations. No DiD or event-study design.
design_notes: main_simulation.R with C++ Gibbs samplers (gibbs_Y, gibbs_Y_mixture, gibbs_BCP_FPA, linear_reg_MC); simulation_analysis.R makes the paper's tables and graphs from the simulation results.
data_files_note: Only calibration parameters ship; all results are simulated.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
